msg: For each pair, it seems as though one is good and one is bad, but this changes throughout the game. For instance, my pairs were purple and grey, red and yellow. For example, if red was giving more mushrooms, then yellow was giving fewer. As the game goes on, this may switch so that yellow is better than red. The same idea goes for purple and grey. I did not notice a pattern with the hats, and I did not notice a pattern with what side the gnomes were on. If a colour was giving 5-10 mushrooms, then this seems to be pretty good. If it starts giving 1-3, maybe switch to the other colour. Also, some of the time both of the colours in a pair aren't very good. If this happens, keep switching until you find a good gnome again.Good luck!
